h: Town centre to the Harbour Arm
p: Sandgate Road is Folkestone's main shopping street, running from the town centre towards the Leas, the grand clifftop promenade with sweeping views over the Channel.

Walk the other way and you'll drop down through the Creative Quarter, a hilly little area of artists' studios and independent shops around the Old High Street, to the harbour. The Harbour Arm has been brilliantly done up with food stalls and bars, and it's a great spot on a sunny day. Admiral itself is strictly 18+, an adult gaming centre rather than a seaside arcade. If you're making a day of it, the Leas and the Harbour Arm are easy to combine on foot, with plenty of fish and chips and cafés along the way.
